title: Vision Plans Summary of Benefits: Routine Eye Exam Schedule
content:
Every one of the Vision Plans (Cascade Vision Exam Plus, Cascade Vision Essential 100, Cascade Vision Select 130, Cascade Vision Select 150, Cascade Vision Choice 175 and Cascade Vision Premier 200) includes a routine eye exam. The schedule below sets, plan by plan, what the member pays for that exam at a participating location, how often the exam benefit renews, and the most a member pays for routine retinal imaging taken with the exam in network.

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Exam copay in network (USD) | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| One routine eye exam per (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Most paid for routine retinal imaging with the exam in network (USD) | 39.00 | 39.00 | 39.00 | 39.00 | 39.00 | 39.00 |

**Reading the schedule**

- The exam copay is the member copay for a routine eye exam in network.
- The exam frequency is one routine eye exam per the stated number of months, counted under the plan's frequency basis.
- The retinal imaging figure is the most a member pays for routine retinal imaging with the exam in network.

**Points of comparison**

- Five plans carry an exam copay of 10.00; Cascade Vision Premier 200 carries an exam copay of 0.00.
- All six plans renew the exam every 12 months, so the plans differ only in how those 12 months are counted.
- The retinal imaging figure is 39.00 on every plan.
